updates.title: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP can now detect and block sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed Windows devices, helping prevent data exfiltration through these file transfer methods. Admins can configure FTP/SFTP activities directly in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce restrictive actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security Integrates with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer, enforce DLP policies across browsers, apps, and AI platforms, and detect insider risk activities. This integration prevents data sharing with untrusted cloud applications including generative AI and social media platforms.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report Now Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now provides a dedicated compliance report for Information Barriers policies that identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This helps admins track and remediate compliance drift across the organization.
